source_prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve / stylized-concept.
Create ONE SINGLE WIDE CHARACTER TURNAROUND SHEET containing THREE coordinated orthographic views of THE SAME HEADLESS CLOTHED BODY: FRONT at left, exact LEFT-SIDE PROFILE facing image LEFT in the middle, BACK at right. This is one coherent modeling design drawn together, not three unrelated illustrations pasted together.
Use a high-resolution LANDSCAPE canvas, ideally 3840 x 1920. All three bodies have IDENTICAL SCALE, neck-top height, shoulder/waist/hip/knee levels and a shared sole baseline. Leave generous separation between views so tails and hands never overlap another view. Pure solid WHITE background. Only small understated labels under the three views: "正面", "左侧", "背面". No title, border, grid, arrows or extra closeups.

INPUT ROLES:
Image 1 = the core front-body costume/proportion/identity reference.
Image 2 = a rough left-profile reference for silhouette and tail port, but its accessory viewing angles are NOT authoritative.
Image 3 = the approved rear-center tail-port garment construction and rear hand orientation, but its copied front-facing tail bow/bell and slipper details MUST be corrected for a genuine back camera.
Reconstruct a SINGLE believable 3D object in your reasoning and rotate the camera around it. Do not simply reproduce the three flawed references independently.

CONSTANT CHARACTER:
No head or hair, only the same short smooth neck connector. Same cute fully clothed stylized proportions, cream oversized open hoodie with pink hood lining/trim/buttons/front patch pockets and cat-face chest patch; pink T-shirt; cream pink-trim drawstring shorts; cream slouch socks with pink bands; pink-and-cream CAT SLIPPERS. Same A-pose: torso upright, straight arms diagonally down/out, straight slightly separated legs and neutral hands. No extra collar/neck bell. Pastel anime illustration with crisp fine outlines, consistent neutral lighting and soft shading.

CRITICAL CONSTRUCTION: TAIL PORT
A small pink-bound oval opening is centered on the hoodie BACK PANEL over the rear pelvis/upper seat. The cream fluffy tail passes THROUGH this enclosed hole, with fur filling it and fabric rim overlapping the root. Intact cream garment fabric and the pink hem continue BELOW the opening. The tail never escapes from under the hem. Position/height of this port is identical in side/back. It is hidden by the body from the front. No exposed skin at the opening.
The single tail projects slightly backward, drops and curves toward the character's ANATOMICAL LEFT, then curls up at the tip. Same resting 3D tail pose in all views: on VIEWER'S RIGHT in front; on VIEWER'S LEFT in back; projecting backward to IMAGE RIGHT in the left profile. Do not switch tail sides or change its pose between columns.

CRITICAL: TAIL BOW AND BELL ARE FIXED OBJECTS, NOT BILLBOARDS
One pink ribbon is tied around the tail near its curled tip, with two loops and two hanging ribbon ends. The knot and suspended gold bell sit on the CHARACTER-FRONT-FACING SIDE of the tail. Their attachment, height and orientation are fixed to the tail in 3D and MUST ROTATE with the camera.
FRONT: see the front of the bow knot and gold bell clearly.
LEFT PROFILE: see a strongly foreshortened side of the bow/loops and side of the spherical bell; NOT the same flat frontal bow pasted at this angle.
BACK: see the rear ribbon wrapping around the fur, back surfaces of the bow loops and some ribbon ends; the central front knot and bell are substantially occluded by the tail/bow. A small part of the smooth gold bell underside may peek below, but DO NOT show a full centered front bell with its front slit or the same frontal knot facing the rear camera. Never duplicate the bow/bell or add a second accessory to the opposite side.

CRITICAL: SLIPPERS ROTATE WITH THE FEET
The cat face and little cat ears exist ONLY on each slipper's TOE CAP.
FRONT: both cat-faced toe caps clearly visible, toes forward.
LEFT PROFILE: one clear side silhouette, toes point IMAGE LEFT, heel IMAGE RIGHT; far foot aligns behind near foot and is mostly occluded. The cat decoration is seen from its side at the TOE, never moved to the heel.
BACK: show plain cream/pink HEELS, pink soles and back of socks. NO cat faces, NO cat ears stuck to the heels, NO pom-poms or rear bows.
Same slipper shape, size, colors and sole thickness in every view.

OTHER VIEW CONSISTENCY:
Front-only buttons, patch pockets, cat chest patch and shorts drawstring stay on the front and are hidden in back. Back hood hangs naturally. Rear view shows HAND BACKS, correct thumbs, five fingers each, subtle nails, not palms. The side is true 90-degree profile, not a three-quarter view; the far arm/leg naturally overlap. Preserve equal costume lengths and tail scale across views.
Deliver one polished three-view reference IMAGE with the entire neck-to-sole bodies and complete tails inside the sheet.
source_correction_prompt:
Edit the provided SINGLE THREE-VIEW BODY SHEET. Keep its three columns, Chinese labels, equal scale, A-pose, clothing, center-back tail hole, hands, colors and white background. This is a technical turnaround correction. Make the following EXACT LOCAL FIXES:

1. RIGHTMOST COLUMN / BACK VIEW: THE TAIL IS ON THE WRONG SIDE.
Keep the tail root fixed at the center-back pink-bound opening. Move the ENTIRE tail curve and attached ribbon/bell to the LEFT of that back-view body (toward the MIDDLE COLUMN), instead of the current right side. The tail must descend from its root and swing DOWN-LEFT, with curled tip to the LEFT of the body. This is because the same tail goes to viewer RIGHT in the FRONT column, and thus to viewer LEFT in the BACK column.
For precision: within the rightmost third of the sheet, keep the root on its local centerline but place the curl/bow mass around the LEFT QUARTER of that third. Do not shift the body or port. Completely remove the previous right-side tail, no duplicate tails. Keep adequate white gap from the middle figure.

2. TAIL BOW/BELL PERSPECTIVE:
LEFTMOST FRONT COLUMN: leave the visible front bow and gold bell unchanged.
MIDDLE SIDE COLUMN: replace the flat front-facing bow at the tail tip with a TRUE SIDE PROFILE of the same fixed bow. Its two loops OVERLAP into a thin compressed layered pink silhouette, NOT two equal face-on wings. The central knot is mostly hidden behind the nearer loop/tail. The bell is seen from the SIDE, a small smooth curved gold surface with attachment, NOT a front-facing dark keyhole slit copied from the first column. Keep the attachment at the same spot along the tail.
RIGHTMOST BACK COLUMN (after moving tail left): show the ribbon's WRAP BAND on the back of the cream tail. The knot and bell sit on the far/front side and are mostly occluded by fur. The BACK surfaces/edges of the bow loops can peek around the tail sides, and two ribbon ends hang down. Do not present a complete front-facing bow knot to the rear camera. Only a small smooth GOLD BELL UNDERSIDE may peek below; no front bell slit. One ribbon and one bell per tail.

3. RIGHTMOST BACK COLUMN / SLIPPERS:
Remove the little pink CAT-EAR TRIANGLES mistakenly visible as decorations at the HEELS. From behind we should see PLAIN rounded cream slipper heel surfaces, pink lower soles and the back of cream socks. The cat faces and cat ears are on the far toe caps, hidden from this back view. No cat features, no raised ear triangles, no bows or pompoms at heels. Keep the same slipper dimensions and sole color.

All other existing details are correct: preserve them. In particular maintain the tail hole IN THE CENTER BACK GARMENT with unbroken fabric and hem below, and the corrected back-facing hands. Do not regenerate the outfit or add a head.
One wide landscape sheet, same framing, high detail, opaque clean white background, only existing labels.
split_method: Lossless rectangular PNG crop. No regeneration or rescaling.
